individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot where each marker is one of the 141 individual samples; marginal histograms show distributions, not averages.
Each point is a mean +/- s.d. across 6 samples per reporter/cell line; the underlying individual replicate measurements are not shown.
Line/density plots showing fitted normal distributions of subtype-averaged values; line plots are exempt from individual point overlay.
Box plot (exempt type) that additionally overlays individual ridge-length data points as dots.
Polar histograms display the full distribution of phase-difference measurements directly as bar heights, not summary averages requiring an overlay.
Polar histogram averaged by subtype, same distribution-type plot as (E), exempt from point overlay.
Single illustrative line trace (example fit), a line-plot type exempt from individual point overlay; not a summary of multiple samples.
Scatter plot where each marker already represents one of the 117 individual samples, with error bars reflecting per-sample fit uncertainty rather than inter-replicate averaging.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars present in this scatter/histogram panel.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5])
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are defined in the caption as mean +/- s.d.
No error bars; these are fitted density/distribution curves.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box plot elements (box, whiskers, median, outliers) are all explicitly defined in the caption.
Polar histogram with no error bars.
Polar histogram with no error bars.
Illustrative schematic trace with no statistical error bars.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are explicitly defined in the caption as the standard deviation of fitted parameters.
